name: delete_then_reuse_alias
description: A connection is deleted, then a brand-new connection is created reusing the exact same alias string. The new connection must get a fresh UUID/display name and must never resurrect the deleted identity's metadata (see test_delete_then_alias_reuse_allocates_new_uuid_and_keeps_tombstone in test_connection_repository_uuid_integration.py for the underlying production contract).
